question: A parallel plate capacitor with plate area $A$ and separation $x$ is connected in series with a resistor $R$ and an ideal battery of constant emf $V$ as shown. The battery remains connected while the plates are pulled apart with constant velocity $v$ so that $x(t)=x_0+vt$. Do not assume a quasi-static process (i.e., do not assume the capacitor voltage instantaneously equals $V$). Which differential equation correctly governs the charge $Q(t)$ (with $I=dQ/dt$) in the circuit?
